source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 905 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 905 was established by Ordinance No. 29265, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 12, 2014. (Ord. 29265)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 905 is established on property located at the northwest corner of Forest Lane and Creekway Drive. The size of PD 905 is approximately 4.42 acres. (Ord. 29265)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 29265)

sections.title: Exhibits
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.104. EXHIBITS.

The following exhibits are incorporated into this article:

(1) Exhibit 905A: development plan.

(2) Exhibit 905B: landscape plan. (Ord. 29265)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For a shared access development, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 905A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) For all other uses, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A- 4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. 29265)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the R-16(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R-16(A) Single Family District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the R-16(A) Single Family District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the R-16(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this district; etc. (Ord. 29265)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.107. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A- 4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted:

-- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator.

(c) The following accessory use is permitted by SUP only:

-- Accessory community center (private). (Ord. 29265)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the R-16(A) Single Family District apply.

(b) Shared access development.

(1) Setbacks. Setbacks are:

(A) 10 feet from Creekway Drive;

(B) 20 feet from Forest Lane;

(C) 20 feet from the alley on the north side of the Property; and

(D) 10 feet from the west Property line.

(2) Density. Maximum number of dwelling units is 18.

(3) Height. Maximum structure height is 30 feet.

(4) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 60 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(5) Lot size. Minimum lot size is 7,150 square feet.

(6) Dwelling unit separation. A minimum separation of 10 feet is required between each dwelling unit. (Ord. 29265)

sections.title: Shared Access Fence
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.109. SHARED ACCESS FENCE.

(a) Except as otherwise provided in this section, a minimum six-foot-high perimeter fence is required in the location shown on the development plan. The perimeter fence may be constructed of stone, masonry, or a combination of stone and masonry. The perimeter fence is allowed in the required setbacks.

(b) The fence along the north side of the Property must be a minimum eight-feet- high. Pedestrian access gates are permitted along the north side of the fence. If provided, the pedestrian access gates along the north side must be constructed of solid materials. (Ord. 29265)

SEC. 51P905.110. SIDEWALKS.

For a shared access development, interior sidewalks are allowed but not required. If provided, interior sidewalks must be a minimum of three-feet wide. (Ord. 29265)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.111. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) Shared access development.

(1) A minimum of two off-street parking spaces are required for each dwelling unit.

(2) Guest parking spaces may cross lot lines. (Ord. 29265)

sections.title: Shared Access Ingress And Egress
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.112. SHARED ACCESS INGRESS AND EGRESS.

(a) Ingress to and egress from the Property must be provided in the locations shown on the development plan. No other ingress or egress is permitted.

(b) Within 18 months after approval of the final plat, an eastbound left turn lane must be approved by the city’s traffic engineer and provided on Forest Lane into Creekway Drive. (Ord. 29265)

sections.title: Shared Access Pavement Widths
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.113. SHARED ACCESS PAVEMENT WIDTHS.

(a) The shared access area must be provided as shown on the development plan.

(b) The shared access area must have a minimum pavement width of 20 feet. Pavement widths are measured perpendicularly from the edge of pavement to the edge of pavement.

(c) Pavement may consist of decorative or stamped paving. (Ord. 29265)

sections.title: Shared Access Development
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.114. SHARED ACCESS DEVELOPMENT.

Except as otherwise provided in this article, the regulations in Division 51A-4.411, “Shared Access Development,” apply. (Ord. 29265)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.115. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 29265)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.116. LANDSCAPING.

(a) In general.

(1) Except as otherwise provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(2) All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition.

(b) Shared access development.

(1) Except as otherwise provided in this subsection, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Section 51A-10.125(a)(2)(B), “Districts Other Than Single Family Districts.”

(2) Landscaping on Lots 1 through 6 and 19, the Creekway Drive setback, and the shared access development entry must be provided as shown on the landscape plan. If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the landscape plan, the text of this article controls.

(A) On Lots 1 through 6, two large canopy trees, per lot, must be provided as shown on the landscape plan within 10 feet of the alley to the north. Additional shrubs that will grow to a minimum height of 15 feet after three years of planting must also be provided within 10 feet of the alley to the north.

(B) The trees on Lot 19 may count toward the site tree and street tree requirements for the Property. (Ord. 29265)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.117. SIGNS.

(a) Except as otherwise provided in the section, signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII.

(b) For shared access developments, monument signs are prohibited. (Ord. 29265)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.118. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) In general.

(1) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(2) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) Shared access development.

(1) On Creekway Drive, one water feature is allowed in the required setback.

(2) The visual obstruction regulations in Section 51A-4.602(d) only apply where the shared access areas intersect with a public street.

(3) For Lots 1 through 6, windows above the first floor that are located on the rear facade must be constructed of translucent materials. (Ord. 29265)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-905.119. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 29265)
